visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Lookup Instead of Ten Comparisons
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Ten separate comparisons check whether a letter is a vowel, upper and lower case. Write an isVowel helper that lower-cases the letter and looks it up. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The set of vowels is written once, lower-casing removes the duplicate upper-case comparisons, and the helper gives the idea a name.
